owner_model.shock_absorber: sealed OCI userspace appliance isolates the ClayVerse continuum from outside variability as far as the container boundary permits
owner_model.durable_writes: UnifiedDB/WAL/checkpoints/effect journal and admitted workspace only in explicit persistent areas
owner_model.runtime: EntityOS/Claude/PTY/tmux reconstructed from immutable image bytes

processing_loop: INGRESS -> UnifiedDB -> context/retrieval -> LLM -> proposed command re-ingest -> policy -> EntityOS -> managed PTY/tmux Linux execution -> stdout/stderr/effect receipt -> UnifiedDB -> EGRESS

recovery.tier_1: restart/fence failed internal component when continuum invariants remain trustworthy
recovery.tier_2: full container fail-closed restart from immutable base when invariants cannot be trusted; recover UnifiedDB/WAL/logical snapshot and mint new generation before reopening ingress

effect_safety: ambiguous external effects are never blindly replayed; UNKNOWN_AFTER_CRASH unless idempotence and durable EffectJournal evidence prove replay safe
host_kernel_boundary: OCI isolates product userspace but shares host kernel; stronger kernel isolation can be supplied by deployment VM/microVM without changing ClayVerse internals
performance_note: fast deterministic restart is required as a design goal; no millisecond guarantee is claimed until measured on admitted runtime
